_note: Dr. Light Numbers for this lab. Canon uses DLN-000 to DLN-08x; ours start at DLN-100.

robots.name: Rush
robots.job: Heartbeat: reads the pj_agent inbox and watched board tasks, drafts replies into an approval queue, flags escalations for Auto (Claude Code).

robots.name: Guts Man
robots.job: Builds dbt models in analytics/ over the lab's own eval data. In training: earns the dbt-model weapon by matching reference models on the dbt-model stage.

robots.name: Roll
robots.job: Housekeeper. Drafts commit messages (later PR bodies) from a diff for Auto or PJ to approve, and triages stale branches `lab git tidy` leaves for review. In training: earns the commit-message weapon on the commit-message stage.
